mainEntity.name: What is involved in a custom kitchen renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom kitchen renovation typically involves a comprehensive redesign of your kitchen space. This includes planning, demolition, and installation of new cabinetry, countertops, flooring, lighting, plumbing, and appliances. Unlike a standard remodel, a custom renovation is tailored specifically to your lifestyle, aesthetic preferences, and functional needs, often incorporating unique materials, layouts, and features to create a truly personalized culinary environment. We work closely with you from concept to completion to ensure every detail meets your vision.
